jobs.title: Entry-Level Machine Learning Engineer
jobs.description:
Job Summary

We are looking for a motivated and enthusiastic Entry-Level Machine Learning Engineer to join our team. The ideal candidate should have a strong foundation in Python, machine learning algorithms, data analysis, and basic statistical concepts. This role offers an opportunity to work on real-world projects, develop AI/ML solutions, and collaborate with experienced professionals.

Key Responsibilities

Develop, train, test, and evaluate machine learning models using Python.
Collect, clean, preprocess, and analyze structured and unstructured datasets.
Implement machine learning algorithms for classification, regression, clustering, and prediction tasks.
Work with libraries such as NumPy, Pandas, Scikit-learn, and Matplotlib.
Assist in developing deep learning and AI-based solutions using TensorFlow or PyTorch.
Evaluate model performance, troubleshoot issues, and improve accuracy.
Collaborate with data engineers and software developers to integrate ML models into applications.
Document experiments, findings, and model development processes.

Required Skills

Basic to intermediate knowledge of Python programming.
Understanding of machine learning algorithms and fundamental statistical concepts.
Familiarity with NumPy, Pandas, Scikit-learn, and data visualization tools.
Knowledge of SQL and database fundamentals.
Understanding of data preprocessing, feature engineering, model evaluation, and validation techniques.
Basic familiarity with TensorFlow, PyTorch, or other deep learning frameworks.
Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills.

Preferred Qualifications

Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Data Science, Statistics, Mathematics, or a related field.
Academic projects, internships, or personal projects in machine learning or artificial intelligence.
Familiarity with Git/GitHub and Jupyter Notebook.
Basic knowledge of cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud is a plus.

jobs.company: Stock: The Logistics of Inventory Donation
jobs.title: Software Engineer
jobs.description:
About Stock

Stock is a B2B marketplace that moves surplus inventory from companies to nonprofits that can use it. We run the whole donation lifecycle: listing, matching, freight and the paperwork that makes it count. Donors clear space and get a tax receipt. Nonprofits get goods they would otherwise buy. Nothing goes to landfill.
We launched to real customers in October 2026. The platform was built end to end by one engineer. You would be the second.

The role

Full stack, no lanes: Elixir and Phoenix on the backend, Next.js and TypeScript on the frontend, Kubernetes and Terraform underneath. You scope a feature with the founders, build it, ship it, watch it in production and fix it when it breaks.
We are open on level, from early-career engineers who have shipped real software to senior engineers who want to build rather than manage. Title, scope and compensation match the person we hire.

Who we're looking for

You have shipped and run a production web app, including the part after launch
You are comfortable across backend, frontend and infrastructure, and strong in at least one
You have worked in a typed or functional language and can pick up Elixir. Prior Elixir is a plus, not a requirement
You have integrated with third-party APIs that misbehave and designed around it
You can turn a vague business problem into scoped, shipped software
You write clearly; most of our design discussion happens in writing

Early in your career? Show us something you built and ran yourself. That counts for more than a resume.

How we work

2 days on site in River North Chicago. Small team, direct access to the founders, a weekly roadmap review. We ship small and often, write decisions down, and use AI coding agents heavily. The work keeps real goods out of landfills and in the hands of nonprofits.

Compensation

Salary: $120,000–$140,000, set by level
Meaningful early-employee equity
Health, dental and vision; flexible PTO; closed between Christmas and New Year's
Your choice of machine and tools

How to apply

Send a short note to david@stockitbetter.com with a link to something you built, a few sentences on why this role, and your favorite ice cream flavor in the subject title ('my favorite ice cream flavor is: <flavor here>). A resume is optional.

Stock is an equal opportunity employer and provides reasonable accommodation throughout the hiring process.

jobs.description:
Job Description

Renesas is looking for an Application Engineer in our Systems Solutions Technology group. The individual is part an overall team that research, architects, designs and builds system end products and modules using Renesas components.

Responsibilities:

Application Engineer will work in a lab setting programing micro controllers and working on system debug.

The individual is part of a team that is exposed to all facets of the design cycle. This person will have an opportunity to participate in each phase of the project. The position requires one to research the final product/ problem, formulate thoughts and ideas utilizing their own creative juices as well as receiving inputs from peers and the product line(s) and propose a solution to the problem.

Upon review, the project is designed, debugged and demonstrated.

This individual will utilize the following lab equipment:

Emulators / In-system debuggers
Power Supplies
Arbitrary Waveform Generators
Oscilloscope
Logic analyzer
Networks Analyzer
Load Supplies.
Soldering equipment

Experience with Renesas proprietary FIT, FSP, PG firmware. Knowledge of Eclipse (e2Studio) IDE is a plus.

System Monitoring & Troubleshooting Serve as an escalation resource for SCADA, MES, PLC, historian, database, communications, and reporting issues. Lead root-cause investigations; improve performance and reliability through corrective actions and tools that reduce recurring incidents.
Industrial Data Systems & Integration Design and improve historian, reporting, and operational data systems. Develop and optimize SQL queries, stored procedures, dashboards, reports, and interfaces; integrate plant-floor and business platforms. Maintain data collection, equipment-context, naming, and quality standards.
Programming & Automation Development Develop applications, scripts, utilities, and reusable tools using SQL, Python, VBA, and related technologies. Industrial Communications Design, configure, integrate, and troubleshoot OPC UA, Modbus TCP, and related protocols across PLCs, SCADA, historians, MES, networks, gateways, and external interfaces. Maintain communication, naming, polling, and reliability standards.
Proficy Historian Support Configure, maintain, and troubleshoot systems and collectors. Establish collection, compression, retention, and archive standards; resolve missing, stale, flatlined, or inconsistent data. Support trending and production analysis; coordinate upgrades, security, backups, and recovery with IT.
Industrial AI & Advanced Analytics Evaluate opportunities and prepare validated data. Support proofs of concept and pilots with success metrics and implementation; integrate approved solutions under change-control and cybersecurity standards. Monitor business value and operational outcomes.
Reliability, Standards & Continuous Improvement Improve availability, maintainability, and performance. Maintain engineering standards, design guidelines, procedures, and documentation; drive permanent corrective actions and project reviews. Promote standardization, scalability, and long-term supportability across facilities.
Leadership & Collaboration Provide guidance during projects, commissioning, and support. Coordinate vendors, contractors, and integrators with company standards. Communicate issues and recommendations across operations, maintenance, engineering, IT, and leadership.
After-Hours Support Participate in critical-system support and escalation. Provide remote or on-site incident response; communicate status and recovery plans. Document incidents, corrective actions, and long-term improvements.

Must have regular and punctual attendance.
Perform all other duties as assigned.

Progressive experience in SCADA/HMI development required, knowledge of MES and manufacturing data systems highly desirable.
Proficient in automation and controls troubleshooting; working knowledge of PLC programming, diagnostics, and communications.
SQL development and database troubleshooting required; experience with Python, VBA, or related scripting languages a plus.
Experience with one or more of the following; OPC, Modbus, iFIX or historian platforms.

Ability to communicate with all levels of employees in written or verbal form.
Ability to solve and communicate complex problems.

High level of ambition and motivation for success, be solutions oriented, results driven, and self-starter.

Experience supporting robotic work cells or advanced manufacturing automation

Work is performed in manufacturing, laboratory, shop, and industrial environments
Exposure to moderate noise levels and manufacturing equipment

jobs.description:
Applied Intuition, Inc. is powering the future of physical AI. Founded in 2017 and now valued at $15 billion, the Silicon Valley company is creating the digital infrastructure needed to bring intelligence to every moving machine on the planet. Applied Intuition services the automotive, defense, trucking, construction, mining and agriculture industries in three core areas: tools and infrastructure, operating systems, and autonomy. Eighteen of the top 20 global automakers, as well as the United States military and its allies, trust the company’s solutions to deliver physical intelligence. Applied Intuition is headquartered in Sunnyvale, California, with offices in Washington, D.C.; San Diego; Ft. Walton Beach, Florida; Ann Arbor, Michigan; London; Stuttgart; Munich; Stockholm; Bangalore; Seoul; and Tokyo. Learn more at applied.co.

We are an in-office company, and our expectation is that full-time employees primarily work from their Applied Intuition office 5 days a week. However, we also recognize the importance of flexibility and trust our employees to manage their schedules responsibly. This may include occasional remote work, starting the day with morning meetings from home before heading to the office, or leaving earlier when needed to accommodate family commitments. This in-office expectation does not apply to contractor positions

About The Role

We are looking for a software engineer with expertise in control of autonomous vehicles or mobile robots. Among your responsibilities will be the development of controls modules that must be high performance due to critical timing constraints.

In addition to your engineering contributions, by working in our dynamic and customer-focused team culture, you will contribute to and learn from best practices in the nascent autonomy industry. We move fast and we focus on excellence, for our products and for our business. If you are hands-on and looking for a place to have a multiplying effect on making autonomous systems a reality, Applied Intuition is the place for you!

At Applied Intuition, You Will

Design and implement controls modules that can be deployed onto vehicles for autonomous navigation
Characterize the dynamics of our customers’ vehicles to create tailored controls solutions and to reduce the gap between simulation and real-world dynamics
Evaluate and utilize academic research to create optimal-control-based solutions using techniques like nonlinear MPC and MPPI control
Diagnose system software and functional driving issues on target platforms, both on-road and in simulation, and drive them to the root cause.
Perform in-vehicle testing: run autonomous drive missions, collect data, and close the loop from field failures to fixes.
Verify and validate autonomy functions from test-case design through fault injection in SIL/HIL and in-vehicle environments.
Contribute to functional and safety requirements and support DFMEA-style failure analysis for safety-critical vehicle functions.
Collaborate with customers’ engineers and manage customer relationships

We're Looking For Someone Who Has

Passion about tackling challenging control problems involving a wide array of vehicles in various environments
Bachelors or Masters in mechanical engineering, computer science or related field with coursework or research experience in controls
2+ years of experience building production software using modern software practices
Hands-on experience testing controls solutions on real, production-grade vehicles
Fluency in differential equations, numerical optimization, numerical analysis, and physics
Enthusiasm for coming up with practical solutions to cutting-edge challenges in a fast-paced environment, and building towards an end-to-end strategy

Nice To Have

Experience writing safety-critical, high-performance software using modern C++
Experience in quadratic programming and nonlinear optimization to create robust and performant controllers
Experience applying machine learning techniques to vehicle dynamics modeling

Compensation at Applied Intuition for eligible roles includes base salary, equity, and benefits. Base salary is a single component of the total compensation package, which may also include equity in the form of options and/or restricted stock units, comprehensive health, dental, vision, life and disability insurance coverage, 401k retirement benefits with employer match, learning and wellness stipends, and paid time off. Note that benefits are subject to change and may vary based on jurisdiction of employment.

Applied Intuition pay ranges reflect the minimum and maximum intended target base salary for new hire salaries for the position. The actual base salary offered to a successful candidate will additionally be influenced by a variety of factors including experience, credentials & certifications, educational attainment, skill level requirements, interview performance, and the level and scope of the position.

WD is building the infrastructure behind the AI-driven data economy.

As AI scales, so does data. Every interaction, every model, every system generates data that must be stored, managed, and made accessible over time. That’s where we come in.

We combine deep engineering expertise with global-scale manufacturing to deliver the storage systems that make AI possible, powering hyperscale data centers, cloud platforms, and enterprise infrastructure worldwide.

This isn’t theoretical work. It’s real systems, at real scale, people solving some of the hardest challenges in technology today.

We’re looking for people who want to build, solve, and operate at that level.

Join us and let’s shape the future of data.

Job Description

This posting supports current and anticipated early-career hiring needs. Applying allows our recruiting team to consider you for opportunities that align with your qualifications, preferences, and availability. An immediate opening or interview is not guaranteed.

Where are these roles located?

Colorado Springs, Colorado
Irvine, California
Longmont, Colorado
Fremont, California
Rochester, Minnesota
San Jose, California

System Tools Software Engineering :

Build the software behind the technology.

As a System Tools Software Engineer
, you'll create the software that powers engineering teams and next-generation products. You'll design, develop, test, and improve tools that make systems faster, more reliable, and easier to build.

In this role, you may:

Design and develop system software, utilities, and engineering tools.
Build or enhance operating systems, compilers, networking tools, databases, and Internet-based applications.
Troubleshoot, debug, and optimize software performance.
Collaborate with hardware and software engineers to ensure seamless integration.
Help influence hardware design by developing software that works efficiently with new technologies.

Applications Software Engineering:

Create software that helps teams work smarter.

As an Applications Software Engineer
, you'll develop applications that support employees, customers, and business operations. You'll design, build, test, and improve software used across enterprise systems.

In this role, you may:

Design, develop, and maintain commercial and internal software applications.
Write clean, efficient, and maintainable code using modern programming languages.
Test, debug, and improve application performance.
Collaborate with teammates to build new features and solve technical problems.
Create documentation that supports software deployment and ongoing maintenance.

Data Analytics Engineering :

Turn data into insights that drive better decisions.

As a Data Analytics Engineer
, you'll build the tools and data systems that help teams understand performance, improve products, and solve business challenges. You'll work with large datasets to create meaningful insights that influence engineering and business decisions.

In this role, you may:

Design and develop data pipelines, databases, and data warehouses.
Build software and automation tools for collecting, processing, and analyzing data.
Create dashboards, reports, and visualizations that support decision-making.
Partner with stakeholders to understand business needs and translate them into technical solutions.
Analyze data to identify trends, improve processes, and solve complex problems.

Firmware Engineering :

Write the code that brings hardware to life.

As a Firmware Engineer
, you'll develop the low-level software that allows hardware devices to function. Working at the intersection of hardware and software, you'll help build reliable, high-performance embedded systems used in next-generation technology.

In this role, you may:

Design, develop, test, and debug embedded firmware.
Write software using C, C++, assembly, and other low-level programming languages.
Collaborate with hardware engineers to integrate software with electronic systems.
Troubleshoot firmware and hardware interactions to improve performance and reliability.
Support new product development from concept through production.

This role is part of WD's early career development program. WD's early career development program is ideal for individuals at the early stages of their professional career. Participants receive foundational training through structured onboarding, mentorship, and a curated development curriculum. The responsibilities of this role are typically aligned with candidates who have approximately 0–2+ years of relevant professional experience, though candidates of all experience levels are encouraged to apply.

Systems Design & Integration Engineering:

Bring complex systems together.

As a Systems Design & Integration Engineer
, you'll help ensure hardware and software work together seamlessly. You'll collaborate across engineering teams to design, integrate, test, and optimize complete system solutions for next-generation products.

In this role, you may:

Define system requirements and technical specifications.
Evaluate hardware and software compatibility.
Coordinate the integration of multiple subsystems into complete products.
Identify, troubleshoot, and resolve system-level issues.
Recommend improvements that enhance system performance, reliability, and scalability.

Qualifications

Required:

Currently pursuing or recently completed a Bachelor's or Master's degree
in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Computer Engineering, Systems Engineering, Data Science, Electrical Engineering, or a related technical field.
Experience developing technical skills through coursework, internships, research, or personal projects using one or more programming languages such as C, C++, Python, Java, Go (Golang), SQL, JavaScript, or similar technologies
.
Familiarity with software development fundamentals, debugging, data structures, algorithms, operating systems, or other computer engineering concepts.
Strong analytical, critical thinking, and problem-solving skills with a passion for learning new technologies.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills and the ability to collaborate effectively in a team environment.
Proficiency with Microsoft Office and common software development tools (such as Git, Linux, or IDEs) is a plus.
Interest in storage technologies, semiconductors, embedded systems, cloud computing, AI, data analytics, or other emerging technologies.

Experience integrating AI solutions with enterprise applications and data ecosystems.

Experience supporting AI solutions in financial services, wealth management, asset management, or other regulated industries.
Experience with AI observability, evaluation frameworks, model monitoring, and LLMOps practices.
Knowledge of cloud-native architectures, CI/CD pipelines, and DevOps methodologies.
Experience designing scalable, highly available enterprise applications.

Strong problem-solving and analytical skills.
Ability to communicate complex AI concepts to technical and non-technical audiences.

jobs.title: Full Stack Engineer
jobs.description:
Intelligems builds the AI agents that turn your traffic into profit. Every day, brands makes thousands of decisions — what to show, what to offer, how to price for each visitor — and most of them happen by default. We build the data and the agents that make those decisions for you, automatically, so your site gets smarter with every visitor instead of sitting static. Our mission is to make every one of those decisions intelligent: grounded in what actually works, not guesswork.

We have excellent traction: we’re working with over 3,000 brands and have access to more than $10B of transaction and shopping session data. We are looking for highly talented individuals to join us and help us continue to scale efficiently. We have an extremely high-performing team, with a collaborative culture of low-ego + high-IQ people. Our people are our strongest asset, and we hold a very high bar.

We're backed by Stage 2 Ventures, Vinyl Capital, Matchstick Ventures, Techstars, and the founders of companies like Klaviyo and Postscript, and have raised >$11M to date.

The Role

Roll up your sleeves and let’s build together! From day one, we’ll ask you to contribute to any and every aspect of our stack. It could be adding new functionality to the core experimentation capabilities of the platform, designing and implementing a new integration, or reworking a complicated user flow.

Our team is lean and mean — less than 10 engineers and only a handful of product and design. This means you’ll work closely with everyone, including those in non-technical roles like our sales, support, and success teams.

Month one will be characterized by “learning by doing” - taking on features that are meaningful in impact with input from other teammates to get deep in the codebase and concepts while also providing value to our customers.

From there you’ll tackle increasingly complex and ambiguous problems. With varying degrees of input from your product and design teammates, you’ll figure out the implementation details from schema and API design to UI polish.

We have thousands of customers, too, so there are often opportunities to work directly or indirectly with them. Understanding the customer perspective and having empathy are important skills that will help make you effective in each of the countless micro design decisions you make each day.

Tech Stack

Knowledge in all of these is not required, but you should be excited to work within and help us improve the stack.

TypeScript monorepo
Frontend - React web app hosted on AWS S3/Cloudfront; Redux, Material UI, ReactQuery
Backend - Serverless NodeJS hosted on AWS Lambda, managed by SST. MySQL database. Also includes SQS queues, Dynamo tables, dockerized lambdas, etc….
“Plugin” - Compiled client-side javascript written in Typescript
Analytics - AWS Eventbus, Kinesis, Flink, Kafka, and Clickhouse.

You’re a Great Fit If

You have experience owning product and feature development from ideation to delivery
You’re able to hold a lot of context in your head — there are a lot of moving pieces here to keep in mind
Exploration, learning, and experimentation are core to your process
You have deep expertise in areas that will level us up
At the same time have curiosity to learn try a different approach
You empathize with our customers, and care deeply about making them successful
You're a team player and can work collaboratively while also being independent
You want to shape the future of e-commerce

Note: please only apply to ONE software engineering role at Intelligems. We are able to move candidates between the Frontend & Full Stack roles as needed.

Benefits For Full-time Employees

Competitive salary and equity packages
Medical, dental, and vision insurance (varies by country)
401k + match (U.S. only)
Flexible PTO policy
Parental leave
$ to spend quarterly with our growing list of brands
WFH setup stipend
Laptop provided
Team meetups and events
Benefits & perks may vary outside of the U.S.

Intelligems is a remote-first company with 4 offices (NYC, Denver, Boston, and Chicago), but please note that some travel may be required.

All Intelligems interviews are transcribed by an AI notetaker.

jobs.title: Software Engineer 1, Full-Stack
jobs.description:
Why Join Us

LoopTech started in 2024 with a question that kept coming up: why is the distance between what AI can do in a lab and what organizations can use so wide? We set out to close it. Our goal is to create intelligent systems that understand and adapt to human needs. We are a research and development group, part think tank and part engineering shop. We live at the edge of what is possible and work backward toward what is practical. We dig into hard problems, build from what we find, and ship tools that teams can put to work the same week they receive them.

LoopTech is part of Cook Medical, a company that operates in regulated industries where precision, privacy, and reliability are requirements. That discipline is in our DNA. Today we ship solutions across conversational AI, medical imaging, and developer experience for organizations that need AI to perform in real work.

If you want to turn research into tools people use, and you want the backing of an established medical device company, we would like to meet you!

Overview

The Software Engineer, Full-Stack
develops, implements and documents software and programs that provide the technical solutions to meet specifications and business requirements defined by company objectives to promote effective, efficient, and compliant operations. This position builds end-to-end (full stack) features across LoopTech's AI products, including the TOPOS tutoring platform, from the user interface through APIs, data, and cloud deployment, using AI-first development workflows.

Responsibilities

Software Development & Delivery

Work as part of a project team to define and document solutions for a variety of software development projects
Contribute to all stages of the software development process, ensuring compliance with software development and architectural standards and achievement of documented requirements
Use AI-first development workflows every day, with fluency in coding agents and harnesses (e.g., Claude Code, Codex) and their plugins, skills, extensions and MCP servers
Review, verify and manage AI-generated code, agent loops and software factory pipelines, acting as the human in the loop: run the tests and check real behavior before merge
Work within the existing and evolving agentic software development lifecycle (SDLC), in which agents are used throughout development
Work test-first (TDD) within a CI/CD workflow, applying SOLID and other sound design principles
Work in an Agile team, balancing research and development with production delivery and software quality

Frontend & Application Development

Build and maintain frontend features for LoopTech web applications, such as course authoring, guided conversations, onboarding, and interactive visualizations
Build with accessibility and mobile/tablet responsiveness as first-class requirements, not an afterthought
Work with UX designers to turn Figma designs and interactive prototypes into production-ready, accessible, responsive interfaces, integrated with backend services, APIs and databases
Validate end-to-end functionality across supported browsers, devices and screen sizes; troubleshoot integration issues and fix bugs
Refine prototypes based on UX feedback, test results and technical requirements, keeping the application maintainable, performant and ready for deployment

Backend, Data & AI Services

Design and extend REST API endpoints and backend services (in Python, Node.js and Rust) that power the student runtime, instructor tooling, and analytics/insights (per-subtopic and per-week mastery tracking)
Design, migrate, and maintain databases (PostgreSQL with pgvector, SQLite) and blob/object file storage
Work on the document ingestion pipeline, including large-file and multi-format uploads (PDF, PPTX, XLSX, CSV, HTML), chapter/outline splitting, deduplication, embedding generation, indexing, and vector search for retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), including graph RAG
Extend these pipelines to build semantic graphs and to transcribe and summarize video and audio
Integrate LLMs through APIs, from hosted providers to self-hosted open models, and real-time voice (LiveKit) to support live, voice-driven Socratic sessions

Security, Identity & Compliance

Implement and harden authentication/authorization flows, including OIDC/SSO federation with university and customer login systems, Microsoft Entra ID, role-based access (student / instructor / account admin), and session management across web and mobile
Support FERPA-aligned data handling, including personally identifiable information (PII), privacy-safe audit trails, data classification, and account/role separation, in partnership with the compliance workstream
Keep secrets and student data out of AI tool context, and follow team rules for agent permissions
Follow product safety rules for sensitive student content, such as crisis disclosures

Infrastructure & Release Engineering

Contribute to infrastructure and release engineering, including Docker or Podman images, Terraform, Kubernetes/Helm deployments, CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions), and coordinated releases across Azure and customer cloud environments

Documentation, Maintenance & Support

Bootstrap, develop, and maintain current-state documentation and deliverables for solutions
Maintain existing and new software systems to ensure they continue to meet user needs
Provide assistance to operational teams to ensure continuity of service
Work with the Software Engineering community of practice to identify and implement continuous improvement opportunities

Required

Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent experience of a kind and amount that provides a comparable background
Git and GitHub familiarity and hygiene, including pull requests, code review, and GitHub Actions CI
18+ months of daily use of AI coding agents and harnesses (e.g., Claude Code, Codex, Pi, OpenCode), with familiarity with agent loops and software factory pipelines, and work or a portfolio you can demonstrate
Ability to read AI research and white papers with high comprehension
Experience with retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) or graph RAG (e.g., Docling for ingestion, pgvector for retrieval, or LangChain-style equivalents)
Experience building production web applications with TypeScript and React (1+ years, or equivalent projects)
Dependency management best practices (e.g., npm or pnpm, uv or pip, Cargo; lockfiles, pinned versions and regular updates)
Strong skills in Python, Node.js (TypeScript) and Rust, with REST API design experience (e.g., FastAPI)
Working experience with PostgreSQL and SQLite, including schema migrations (e.g., SQLAlchemy, Alembic)
Docker or Podman basics
Test-first development (e.g., pytest, Vitest)
Data hygiene, including safe handling of secrets and data
Ability to work across frontend and backend within the same feature and to communicate trade-offs clearly
Ability to take UX/UI designs and implement them faithfully
Experience working in an Agile team

Professional Competencies

Apply excellent analytical and problem-solving skillsCommunicate technical concepts clearly, in writing and verbally, to technical and non-technical audiences Work and interact effectively and professionally with and for others throughout various levels of the global organization
Work effectively in both collaborative and independent environments with minimal supervision
Remain calm and receptive in fast-paced situations
Fluency in Artificial Intelligence (AI) This role requires fluency in Artificial Intelligence (AI) and data concepts, including the ability to critically evaluate AI outputs, improve workflows using approved tools, identify and mitigate bias or inaccuracies, and communicate AI-driven insights clearly and responsibly to peers and managers.
Workplace Standards
Strictly adhere to safety requirements
Maintain regular and punctual attendance
Maintain company quality and quantity standards
Perform other duties as assigned

Preferred

Experience developing interactive, data-driven interfaces, including dashboards, knowledge maps, and graph or network visualizations using tools such as D3.js.
Playwright and accessibility testing (WCAG); responsive interfaces for mobile and tablet devices.
Experience integrating real-time media and streaming technologies, such as LiveKit, WebRTC, or WebSockets, into voice or conversational applications.
Familiarity with handling personally identifiable information (e.g., FERPA or HIPAA; education or healthcare data).
Kubernetes and Helm, including self-hosted clusters (e.g., OpenStack Magnum) alongside managed cloud services.
OIDC/SSO and Microsoft Entra ID (MSAL) in multi-role applications.
Experience working in startups, EdTech, healthcare technology, or other regulated environments that require close collaboration with institutional partners.[EB3.1]
LLM-powered conversational products, including prompt design, multi-agent orchestration, evaluation of response quality, and basic statistics.
Self-hosted or open-weight models and OpenAI-compatible model serving.
Go as an additional backend language.
Mobile or desktop app development (Android, iOS, macOS, Electron).
Operating services on Azure; Terraform or other infrastructure as code.
Familiarity with fine-tuning models.
Awareness of calibrated decision models.
Background workers and pipelines, including race conditions and idempotency.
Self-hosted Git and CI (e.g., Forgejo).
Container/image security scanning (e.g., Trivy), semantic-version release workflows, and observability (e.g., OpenTelemetry).

jobs.title: Sr. Software Engineer - Data AI Platforms
jobs.description:
Job Description

Our vision is to enable profitable growth to Aramark's Accounts by providing them with analytical assets that meet their needs as effectively and then efficiently as possible. To achieve this vision, Aramark will deliver strategic data assets that enable our operators to maximize the hospitality experience for our consumers and clients.

We are seeking a Senior Software Engineer to join our team as a key technical contributor on the Document Intelligence Worker platform ? a cloud-native, event-driven system that ingests, classifies, and processes documents at scale using AI agentic workflows. You will design and operate the pipelines and services that power automated document understanding and downstream analytics and AI-driven capabilities across Aramark, processing 1000+ documents per month for 12+ Lines of Business. You will work across Azure Blob Storage, Event Grid, Service Bus, Container Apps Jobs, AI Search, Cosmos DB, and Azure AI Foundry.

This is a hybrid role based at our Philadelphia headquarters. Candidates must be local to the area or willing to relocate, and able to work onsite in a hybrid capacity.

Job Responsibilities

Design, build, and own components of the Document Intelligence Worker pipeline, including ingestion, classification, extraction, and downstream delivery to consumer applications, making design decisions that account for scalability, cost, and reliability.
Architect and implement event-driven processing using Azure Blob Storage, Event Grid, and Service Bus, with Container Apps Jobs scaled via KEDA.
Build and productionize AI agentic workflows using Azure AI Foundry ? including orchestration, tool use, and multi-step reasoning over unstructured documents.
Implement and maintain retrieval and indexing layers using Azure AI Search and Cosmos DB to support downstream search, analytics, and agentic retrieval.
Design and build the application layer for agentic AI solutions ? backend services and APIs (including authentication and orchestration between the UI and platform services) and React-based user interfaces such as chat, document review/approval tools, and agent monitoring dashboards.
Own monitoring, observability, testing, and recovery mechanisms for production pipelines, including on-call support for critical incidents.
Drive integration and synchronization work between source systems (on-premises and SaaS) and cloud-native platforms, working through dependencies across teams.
Contribute to data engineering best practices ? CI/CD for data and services, testing standards, and code and design review norms ? and mentor junior and mid-level engineers and interns.
Partner with product, engineering, and business stakeholders on technical trade-offs, feasibility, and cost, translating requirements into reliable, scalable data and AI services and explaining complex AI and data concepts to non-technical audiences.
Evaluate and prototype emerging document intelligence and agentic AI techniques, and recommend their adoption where they add measurable value, weighing cost and risk.

Qualifications

BS or MS in Computer Science, Data Engineering, Data Science, or a related field, with 8+ years (or 6+ with an MS) of professional experience across data engineering and software development (including full-stack development with backend services), including 3+ years of hands-on experience building applied AI, machine learning, or data science solutions, with production experience building LLM-powered and AI agentic applications, plus experience in document intelligence (OCR, IDP, document classification/extraction). This includes:

Full-stack development experience, including backend services and API design (e.g., REST, authentication/authorization, service-to-service integration) and React frontend development, sufficient to build UIs for agentic AI applications (e.g., chat interfaces, document review/approval tools, agent monitoring dashboards).
Strong proficiency in Python and SQL, with production experience building and operating data or AI services.
Hands-on experience with a major cloud platform (Azure, AWS, or GCP), including object storage, event-driven messaging, and container orchestration with autoscaling. Experience with Azure services (Blob Storage, Event Grid, Service Bus, Container Apps, KEDA) is preferred.
Experience building or integrating AI agentic workflows and LLM-enabled applications ? e.g., via Azure AI Foundry, AWS Bedrock, Vertex AI, LangChain, Semantic Kernel, AutoGen, or comparable frameworks.
Experience with document intelligence / intelligent document processing tooling (e.g., Azure Document Intelligence, AWS Textract, Google Document AI, OCR pipelines, layout- or vision-based extraction models).
Experience with vector search and retrieval-augmented generation, including Azure AI Search or equivalent (e.g., Elasticsearch, Pinecone, Weaviate).
Experience with NoSQL/document databases such as Cosmos DB, DynamoDB, or Firestore, and designing data models for high-throughput, low-latency workloads.
Solid grounding in CI/CD practices, version control (Git), automated testing, and production monitoring/observability.
Comfortable working across distributed teams, with a track record of working with both engineers and non-technical business stakeholders and adapting communication to the audience.

Preferred Qualifications

new_jobs.title: Software Engineer
new_jobs.description:
About Stock

Stock is a B2B marketplace that moves surplus inventory from companies to nonprofits that can use it. We run the whole donation lifecycle: listing, matching, freight and the paperwork that makes it count. Donors clear space and get a tax receipt. Nonprofits get goods they would otherwise buy. Nothing goes to landfill.
We launched to real customers in October 2026. The platform was built end to end by one engineer. You would be the second.

The role

Full stack, no lanes: Elixir and Phoenix on the backend, Next.js and TypeScript on the frontend, Kubernetes and Terraform underneath. You scope a feature with the founders, build it, ship it, watch it in production and fix it when it breaks.
We are open on level, from early-career engineers who have shipped real software to senior engineers who want to build rather than manage. Title, scope and compensation match the person we hire.

Who we're looking for

You have shipped and run a production web app, including the part after launch
You are comfortable across backend, frontend and infrastructure, and strong in at least one
You have worked in a typed or functional language and can pick up Elixir. Prior Elixir is a plus, not a requirement
You have integrated with third-party APIs that misbehave and designed around it
You can turn a vague business problem into scoped, shipped software
You write clearly; most of our design discussion happens in writing

Early in your career? Show us something you built and ran yourself. That counts for more than a resume.

How we work

2 days on site in River North Chicago. Small team, direct access to the founders, a weekly roadmap review. We ship small and often, write decisions down, and use AI coding agents heavily. The work keeps real goods out of landfills and in the hands of nonprofits.

Compensation

Salary: $120,000–$140,000, set by level
Meaningful early-employee equity
Health, dental and vision; flexible PTO; closed between Christmas and New Year's
Your choice of machine and tools

How to apply

Send a short note to david@stockitbetter.com with a link to something you built, a few sentences on why this role, and your favorite ice cream flavor in the subject title ('my favorite ice cream flavor is: <flavor here>). A resume is optional.

Stock is an equal opportunity employer and provides reasonable accommodation throughout the hiring process.

We are looking for a motivated person to develop and maintain SCADA/MES systems. Qualified applicants will provide technical leadership for automation software, industrial communications, data collection, and operational reporting. Position is responsible for designing, developing, supporting, and improving SCADA, MES, historian, and industrial data systems.

SCADA & MES Engineering Lead application development, enhancement, and lifecycle support. Translate operational requirements into solutions; maintain graphics, tag, alarm, database, and deployment standards. Support commissioning, startup, upgrades, validation, and software-change review and approval.
System Monitoring & Troubleshooting Serve as an escalation resource for SCADA, MES, PLC, historian, database, communications, and reporting issues. Lead root-cause investigations; improve performance and reliability through corrective actions and tools that reduce recurring incidents.
Industrial Data Systems & Integration Design and improve historian, reporting, and operational data systems. Develop and optimize SQL queries, stored procedures, dashboards, reports, and interfaces; integrate plant-floor and business platforms. Maintain data collection, equipment-context, naming, and quality standards.
Programming & Automation Development Develop applications, scripts, utilities, and reusable tools using SQL, Python, VBA, and related technologies. Automate manual work and improve deployment, diagnostics, reporting, and monitoring using documentation, testing, version control, change management, and rollback planning.
Industrial Communications Design, configure, integrate, and troubleshoot OPC UA, Modbus TCP, and related protocols across PLCs, SCADA, historians, MES, networks, gateways, and external interfaces. Maintain communication, naming, polling, and reliability standards.
Proficy Historian Support Configure, maintain, and troubleshoot systems and collectors. Establish collection, compression, retention, and archive standards; resolve missing, stale, flatlined, or inconsistent data. Support trending and production analysis; coordinate upgrades, security, backups, and recovery with IT.
Industrial AI & Advanced Analytics Evaluate opportunities and prepare validated data. Support proofs of concept and pilots with success metrics and implementation; integrate approved solutions under change-control and cybersecurity standards. Monitor business value and operational outcomes.
Reliability, Standards & Continuous Improvement Improve availability, maintainability, and performance. Maintain engineering standards, design guidelines, procedures, and documentation; drive permanent corrective actions and project reviews. Promote standardization, scalability, and long-term supportability across facilities.
Leadership & Collaboration Provide guidance during projects, commissioning, and support. Coordinate vendors, contractors, and integrators with company standards. Communicate issues and recommendations across operations, maintenance, engineering, IT, and leadership.
After-Hours Support Participate in critical-system support and escalation. Provide remote or on-site incident response; communicate status and recovery plans. Document incidents, corrective actions, and long-term improvements.

Additional

Ability to perform all essential job functions with or without reasonable accommodation.
Must have regular and punctual attendance.
Perform all other duties as assigned.

Skills And Abilities

Progressive experience in SCADA/HMI development required, knowledge of MES and manufacturing data systems highly desirable.
Proficient in automation and controls troubleshooting; working knowledge of PLC programming, diagnostics, and communications.
SQL development and database troubleshooting required; experience with Python, VBA, or related scripting languages a plus.
Experience with one or more of the following; OPC, Modbus, iFIX or historian platforms.

Demonstrated Competencies

Ability to communicate with all levels of employees in written or verbal form.
Ability to solve and communicate complex problems.
Strategic planning and organizational ability.
Provide data driven results to lead and influence decisions.
High level of ambition and motivation for success, be solutions oriented, results driven, and self-starter.

Physical Requirements

Office setting and industrial manufacturing setting.

Experience
Minimum of 3 years relevant SCADA/HMI development. Experience in a manufacturing environment is desired.

Education
Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Software Engineering, Computer Science, Mechanical Engineering, Industrial Engineering, or a related technical discipline; OR an equivalent combination of technical education and applicable automation, controls, SCADA, MES, or software engineering experience.

Work closely with controls engineers, project managers, and end users to define system requirements

is a biopharmaceutical Contract Development and Manufacturing Organization (CDMO) that specializes in advancing novel gene therapies from concept to commercialization.
Located in Columbus, OH

Our Values are founded in our origin story.

The name “Andelyn”
is a hybrid of two gene therapy patients
who participated in pivotal Phase I clinical trials at Nationwide Children’s Hospital. Andrew received the first U.S. investigational gene therapy for Duchenne muscular dystrophy in 2006. Evelyn received experimental gene therapy for spinal muscular atrophy in 2015. “Andelyn” combines their names to represent all the families who have courageously participated in the research that makes today’s gene therapies possible.
Through this journey, we have been able to accelerate the
development and manufacturing of innovative therapies to bring more treatments to more patients. We are Turning Hope Into Reality™ through our ACCTS
ions.

ions.

This includes implementation of changes to the Automation systems, updating design documents, executing testing, troubleshooting events, and being a part of Automation on-call support. This role focuses on supporting the delivery of automated solutions to support Process Development, Downstream/Upstream process, Facilities/Utilities, Warehouse and areas including Lab, Media Preparation, Seed Culture, Small/Large Scale Bioreactors, and Harvest.

Applied Intuition, Inc. is powering the future of physical AI. Founded in 2017 and now valued at $15 billion, the Silicon Valley company is creating the digital infrastructure needed to bring intelligence to every moving machine on the planet. Applied Intuition services the automotive, defense, trucking, construction, mining and agriculture industries in three core areas: tools and infrastructure, operating systems, and autonomy. Eighteen of the top 20 global automakers, as well as the United States military and its allies, trust the company’s solutions to deliver physical intelligence. Applied Intuition is headquartered in Sunnyvale, California, with offices in Washington, D.C.; San Diego; Ft. Walton Beach, Florida; Ann Arbor, Michigan; London; Stuttgart; Munich; Stockholm; Bangalore; Seoul; and Tokyo. Learn more at applied.co.

We are an in-office company, and our expectation is that full-time employees primarily work from their Applied Intuition office 5 days a week. However, we also recognize the importance of flexibility and trust our employees to manage their schedules responsibly. This may include occasional remote work, starting the day with morning meetings from home before heading to the office, or leaving earlier when needed to accommodate family commitments. This in-office expectation does not apply to contractor positions

About The Role

We are looking for a software engineer with expertise in control of autonomous vehicles or mobile robots. Among your responsibilities will be the development of controls modules that must be high performance due to critical timing constraints.

In addition to your engineering contributions, by working in our dynamic and customer-focused team culture, you will contribute to and learn from best practices in the nascent autonomy industry. We move fast and we focus on excellence, for our products and for our business. If you are hands-on and looking for a place to have a multiplying effect on making autonomous systems a reality, Applied Intuition is the place for you!

At Applied Intuition, You Will

Design and implement controls modules that can be deployed onto vehicles for autonomous navigation
Characterize the dynamics of our customers’ vehicles to create tailored controls solutions and to reduce the gap between simulation and real-world dynamics
Evaluate and utilize academic research to create optimal-control-based solutions using techniques like nonlinear MPC and MPPI control
Diagnose system software and functional driving issues on target platforms, both on-road and in simulation, and drive them to the root cause.
Perform in-vehicle testing: run autonomous drive missions, collect data, and close the loop from field failures to fixes.
Verify and validate autonomy functions from test-case design through fault injection in SIL/HIL and in-vehicle environments.
Contribute to functional and safety requirements and support DFMEA-style failure analysis for safety-critical vehicle functions.
Collaborate with customers’ engineers and manage customer relationships

We're Looking For Someone Who Has

Passion about tackling challenging control problems involving a wide array of vehicles in various environments
Bachelors or Masters in mechanical engineering, computer science or related field with coursework or research experience in controls
2+ years of experience building production software using modern software practices
Hands-on experience testing controls solutions on real, production-grade vehicles
Fluency in differential equations, numerical optimization, numerical analysis, and physics
Enthusiasm for coming up with practical solutions to cutting-edge challenges in a fast-paced environment, and building towards an end-to-end strategy

Nice To Have

Experience writing safety-critical, high-performance software using modern C++
Experience in quadratic programming and nonlinear optimization to create robust and performant controllers
Experience applying machine learning techniques to vehicle dynamics modeling

In this role, you may:

Design and develop system software, utilities, and engineering tools.
Build or enhance operating systems, compilers, networking tools, databases, and Internet-based applications.
Troubleshoot, debug, and optimize software performance.
Collaborate with hardware and software engineers to ensure seamless integration.

As a Firmware Engineer

In this role, you may:

Design, develop, test, and debug embedded firmware.
Write software using C, C++, assembly, and other low-level programming languages.

Bring complex systems together.

As a Systems Design & Integration Engineer

In this role, you may:

Define system requirements and technical specifications.
Evaluate hardware and software compatibility.
Coordinate the integration of multiple subsystems into complete products.
Identify, troubleshoot, and resolve system-level issues.
Recommend improvements that enhance system performance, reliability, and scalability.

in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Computer Engineering, Systems Engineering, Data Science, Electrical Engineering, or a related technical field.
Experience developing technical skills through coursework, internships, research, or personal projects using one or more programming languages such as C, C++, Python, Java, Go (Golang), SQL, JavaScript, or similar technologies

System Tools Software Intern :

Design, develop, test, and debug embedded firmware.
Write software using C, C++, assembly, and other low-level programming languages.
Collaborate with hardware engineers to integrate software with electronic systems.

Support new product development from concept through production.

new_jobs.title: Full Stack Engineer
new_jobs.description:
Intelligems builds the AI agents that turn your traffic into profit. Every day, brands makes thousands of decisions — what to show, what to offer, how to price for each visitor — and most of them happen by default. We build the data and the agents that make those decisions for you, automatically, so your site gets smarter with every visitor instead of sitting static. Our mission is to make every one of those decisions intelligent: grounded in what actually works, not guesswork.

We have excellent traction: we’re working with over 3,000 brands and have access to more than $10B of transaction and shopping session data. We are looking for highly talented individuals to join us and help us continue to scale efficiently. We have an extremely high-performing team, with a collaborative culture of low-ego + high-IQ people. Our people are our strongest asset, and we hold a very high bar.

We're backed by Stage 2 Ventures, Vinyl Capital, Matchstick Ventures, Techstars, and the founders of companies like Klaviyo and Postscript, and have raised >$11M to date.

The Role

Roll up your sleeves and let’s build together! From day one, we’ll ask you to contribute to any and every aspect of our stack. It could be adding new functionality to the core experimentation capabilities of the platform, designing and implementing a new integration, or reworking a complicated user flow.

Our team is lean and mean — less than 10 engineers and only a handful of product and design. This means you’ll work closely with everyone, including those in non-technical roles like our sales, support, and success teams.

Month one will be characterized by “learning by doing” - taking on features that are meaningful in impact with input from other teammates to get deep in the codebase and concepts while also providing value to our customers.

From there you’ll tackle increasingly complex and ambiguous problems. With varying degrees of input from your product and design teammates, you’ll figure out the implementation details from schema and API design to UI polish.

We have thousands of customers, too, so there are often opportunities to work directly or indirectly with them. Understanding the customer perspective and having empathy are important skills that will help make you effective in each of the countless micro design decisions you make each day.

Tech Stack

Knowledge in all of these is not required, but you should be excited to work within and help us improve the stack.

TypeScript monorepo
Frontend - React web app hosted on AWS S3/Cloudfront; Redux, Material UI, ReactQuery
Backend - Serverless NodeJS hosted on AWS Lambda, managed by SST. MySQL database. Also includes SQS queues, Dynamo tables, dockerized lambdas, etc….
“Plugin” - Compiled client-side javascript written in Typescript
Analytics - AWS Eventbus, Kinesis, Flink, Kafka, and Clickhouse.

You’re a Great Fit If

You have experience owning product and feature development from ideation to delivery
You’re able to hold a lot of context in your head — there are a lot of moving pieces here to keep in mind
Exploration, learning, and experimentation are core to your process
You have deep expertise in areas that will level us up
At the same time have curiosity to learn try a different approach
You empathize with our customers, and care deeply about making them successful
You're a team player and can work collaboratively while also being independent
You want to shape the future of e-commerce

Note: please only apply to ONE software engineering role at Intelligems. We are able to move candidates between the Frontend & Full Stack roles as needed.

Benefits For Full-time Employees

Competitive salary and equity packages
Medical, dental, and vision insurance (varies by country)
401k + match (U.S. only)
Flexible PTO policy
Parental leave
$ to spend quarterly with our growing list of brands
WFH setup stipend
Laptop provided
Team meetups and events
Benefits & perks may vary outside of the U.S.

Intelligems is a remote-first company with 4 offices (NYC, Denver, Boston, and Chicago), but please note that some travel may be required.

All Intelligems interviews are transcribed by an AI notetaker.

new_jobs.title: Software Engineer 1, Full-Stack
new_jobs.description:
Why Join Us

LoopTech started in 2024 with a question that kept coming up: why is the distance between what AI can do in a lab and what organizations can use so wide? We set out to close it. Our goal is to create intelligent systems that understand and adapt to human needs. We are a research and development group, part think tank and part engineering shop. We live at the edge of what is possible and work backward toward what is practical. We dig into hard problems, build from what we find, and ship tools that teams can put to work the same week they receive them.

LoopTech is part of Cook Medical, a company that operates in regulated industries where precision, privacy, and reliability are requirements. That discipline is in our DNA. Today we ship solutions across conversational AI, medical imaging, and developer experience for organizations that need AI to perform in real work.

If you want to turn research into tools people use, and you want the backing of an established medical device company, we would like to meet you!

Overview

The Software Engineer, Full-Stack
develops, implements and documents software and programs that provide the technical solutions to meet specifications and business requirements defined by company objectives to promote effective, efficient, and compliant operations. This position builds end-to-end (full stack) features across LoopTech's AI products, including the TOPOS tutoring platform, from the user interface through APIs, data, and cloud deployment, using AI-first development workflows.

Responsibilities

Software Development & Delivery

Work as part of a project team to define and document solutions for a variety of software development projects
Contribute to all stages of the software development process, ensuring compliance with software development and architectural standards and achievement of documented requirements
Use AI-first development workflows every day, with fluency in coding agents and harnesses (e.g., Claude Code, Codex) and their plugins, skills, extensions and MCP servers
Review, verify and manage AI-generated code, agent loops and software factory pipelines, acting as the human in the loop: run the tests and check real behavior before merge
Work within the existing and evolving agentic software development lifecycle (SDLC), in which agents are used throughout development
Work test-first (TDD) within a CI/CD workflow, applying SOLID and other sound design principles
Work in an Agile team, balancing research and development with production delivery and software quality

Frontend & Application Development

Build and maintain frontend features for LoopTech web applications, such as course authoring, guided conversations, onboarding, and interactive visualizations
Build with accessibility and mobile/tablet responsiveness as first-class requirements, not an afterthought
Work with UX designers to turn Figma designs and interactive prototypes into production-ready, accessible, responsive interfaces, integrated with backend services, APIs and databases
Validate end-to-end functionality across supported browsers, devices and screen sizes; troubleshoot integration issues and fix bugs
Refine prototypes based on UX feedback, test results and technical requirements, keeping the application maintainable, performant and ready for deployment

Backend, Data & AI Services

Design and extend REST API endpoints and backend services (in Python, Node.js and Rust) that power the student runtime, instructor tooling, and analytics/insights (per-subtopic and per-week mastery tracking)
Design, migrate, and maintain databases (PostgreSQL with pgvector, SQLite) and blob/object file storage
Work on the document ingestion pipeline, including large-file and multi-format uploads (PDF, PPTX, XLSX, CSV, HTML), chapter/outline splitting, deduplication, embedding generation, indexing, and vector search for retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), including graph RAG
Extend these pipelines to build semantic graphs and to transcribe and summarize video and audio
Integrate LLMs through APIs, from hosted providers to self-hosted open models, and real-time voice (LiveKit) to support live, voice-driven Socratic sessions

Security, Identity & Compliance

Implement and harden authentication/authorization flows, including OIDC/SSO federation with university and customer login systems, Microsoft Entra ID, role-based access (student / instructor / account admin), and session management across web and mobile
Support FERPA-aligned data handling, including personally identifiable information (PII), privacy-safe audit trails, data classification, and account/role separation, in partnership with the compliance workstream
Keep secrets and student data out of AI tool context, and follow team rules for agent permissions
Follow product safety rules for sensitive student content, such as crisis disclosures

Infrastructure & Release Engineering

Contribute to infrastructure and release engineering, including Docker or Podman images, Terraform, Kubernetes/Helm deployments, CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions), and coordinated releases across Azure and customer cloud environments

Documentation, Maintenance & Support

Bootstrap, develop, and maintain current-state documentation and deliverables for solutions
Maintain existing and new software systems to ensure they continue to meet user needs
Provide assistance to operational teams to ensure continuity of service
Work with the Software Engineering community of practice to identify and implement continuous improvement opportunities

Required

Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent experience of a kind and amount that provides a comparable background
Git and GitHub familiarity and hygiene, including pull requests, code review, and GitHub Actions CI
18+ months of daily use of AI coding agents and harnesses (e.g., Claude Code, Codex, Pi, OpenCode), with familiarity with agent loops and software factory pipelines, and work or a portfolio you can demonstrate
Ability to read AI research and white papers with high comprehension
Experience with retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) or graph RAG (e.g., Docling for ingestion, pgvector for retrieval, or LangChain-style equivalents)
Experience building production web applications with TypeScript and React (1+ years, or equivalent projects)
Dependency management best practices (e.g., npm or pnpm, uv or pip, Cargo; lockfiles, pinned versions and regular updates)
Strong skills in Python, Node.js (TypeScript) and Rust, with REST API design experience (e.g., FastAPI)
Working experience with PostgreSQL and SQLite, including schema migrations (e.g., SQLAlchemy, Alembic)
Docker or Podman basics
Test-first development (e.g., pytest, Vitest)
Data hygiene, including safe handling of secrets and data
Ability to work across frontend and backend within the same feature and to communicate trade-offs clearly
Ability to take UX/UI designs and implement them faithfully
Experience working in an Agile team

Professional Competencies

Apply excellent analytical and problem-solving skillsCommunicate technical concepts clearly, in writing and verbally, to technical and non-technical audiences Work and interact effectively and professionally with and for others throughout various levels of the global organization
Work effectively in both collaborative and independent environments with minimal supervision
Remain calm and receptive in fast-paced situations
Fluency in Artificial Intelligence (AI) This role requires fluency in Artificial Intelligence (AI) and data concepts, including the ability to critically evaluate AI outputs, improve workflows using approved tools, identify and mitigate bias or inaccuracies, and communicate AI-driven insights clearly and responsibly to peers and managers.
Workplace Standards
Strictly adhere to safety requirements
Maintain regular and punctual attendance
Maintain company quality and quantity standards
Perform other duties as assigned

Preferred

Experience developing interactive, data-driven interfaces, including dashboards, knowledge maps, and graph or network visualizations using tools such as D3.js.
Playwright and accessibility testing (WCAG); responsive interfaces for mobile and tablet devices.
Experience integrating real-time media and streaming technologies, such as LiveKit, WebRTC, or WebSockets, into voice or conversational applications.
Familiarity with handling personally identifiable information (e.g., FERPA or HIPAA; education or healthcare data).
Kubernetes and Helm, including self-hosted clusters (e.g., OpenStack Magnum) alongside managed cloud services.
OIDC/SSO and Microsoft Entra ID (MSAL) in multi-role applications.
Experience working in startups, EdTech, healthcare technology, or other regulated environments that require close collaboration with institutional partners.[EB3.1]
LLM-powered conversational products, including prompt design, multi-agent orchestration, evaluation of response quality, and basic statistics.
Self-hosted or open-weight models and OpenAI-compatible model serving.
Go as an additional backend language.
Mobile or desktop app development (Android, iOS, macOS, Electron).
Operating services on Azure; Terraform or other infrastructure as code.
Familiarity with fine-tuning models.
Awareness of calibrated decision models.
Background workers and pipelines, including race conditions and idempotency.
Self-hosted Git and CI (e.g., Forgejo).
Container/image security scanning (e.g., Trivy), semantic-version release workflows, and observability (e.g., OpenTelemetry).

new_jobs.description:
Want to help everyday Americans invest and build wealth? Financial inequality is increasing, and too many people are getting left behind. At Stash, we're passionate about democratizing wealth creation through education, advice, and products that help customers achieve greater financial freedom. We also believe in working smarter, using AI and emerging technologies to move faster, operate more eﬃciently, and focus our time on solving meaningful problems for our customers.

As a key member of the Dev Leverage team, you will own the path our engineers use to ship. That path is shared CI/CD, trunk-based delivery, and a default way to start a new service. The estate is real and mixed: Go and other languages, GitHub Actions and remaining CircleCI, Kubernetes on AWS, and a trunk standard we are still rolling out. We are looking for engineers who like building the tool everyone else uses, and who are careful when a one-line workflow change can land on many teams at once.

This position operates on a hybrid schedule, requiring you to be on-site in our New York office at least three days per week to work with stakeholders and foster team collaboration.

What you'll do:

Design, build, and maintain the shared CI/CD workflows Stash services use to test and deploy.
Move services onto trunk-based delivery: one main branch, squash merges, and one immutable artifact promoted from edge to staging to production.
Replace one-oﬀ pipelines with a paved road: reusable GitHub Actions, a default path for a new service, and docs that match the workflow that runs.
Keep that path reliable. Runners, failed jobs, and deploy health need a clear owner when something breaks.
Partner with application teams, infrastructure, and security so the standard stays safe and teams can adopt it without a bespoke design.
Use AI coding tools to migrate and implement faster, and keep review and production gates in place so generated changes stay safe.
Debug, test, and document the workflows themselves. A change here is a change for many teams.

What we're looking for:

3 to 5 years of professional experience in backend or platform engineering.
Proof you have owned CI/CD other people use. GitHub Actions preferred. CircleCI or a similar system counts if you have built reusable workflows, promotions, and secrets handling.
Strong proficiency in Go, or deep experience in another backend language (TypeScript, Ruby, Python, or Rails) with a willingness to work across stacks.
Experience shipping with trunk-based development or continuous delivery, including immutable artifacts and environment promotion.
Hands-on experience with cloud platforms (AWS) and containers.
A habit of measuring blast radius before you merge. You have broken a shared system before, and you changed how you work because of it.
Excellent problem-solving skills and a mindset for continuous improvement.
Clear writing. App teams will follow your workflow only if the docs and the pull request explain the why.

Gold Stars:

Terraform and Argo CD.
Package registries such as Artifactory or GitHub Packages.
Datadog or similar observability for CI and deploys.
A migration you led oﬀ a legacy CI system.
Familiarity with banking or fintech systems.
